svg.title: YellowShifts
svg.desc: Shift scheduling and attendance for fuel stations. In pilot at a working Paz station. Workers clock in by tapping an NFC tag. Access enforced by Postgres row-level security. One hours engine for web, admin and mobile. Built with Next.js 16, Expo, Supabase. paz.darb.co.il
